# La Soirée Bridal
> Private, appointment-only bridal boutique in Richland, Michigan (near Kalamazoo; about an hour from Grand Rapids) carrying curated European wedding gowns by Eva Lendel, Anna Sposa, DAMA Couture, Luce Sposa and the house collection Soirée. Gowns $1,500–$6,000 (most $2,500–$3,000).

- Address: 8880 N 32nd Street, Suite 1, Richland, MI 49083 · 269-220-0440 · hello@lasoireebridal.com
- Appointments: 1 hour ($25, up to 4 guests), 2 hours ($50, up to 4 guests), Champagne VIP ($125, 2 hours, entire boutique, up to 6 guests), return visit (free, 30 min)
- [Book an appointment](https://lasoireebridal.com/book/)
- [The collection](https://lasoireebridal.com/collection/)
- [Designers](https://lasoireebridal.com/designers/)
- [FAQ](https://lasoireebridal.com/faq/)
